name: Jig
description: Wakes Jig's dispatcher when an agent stops for input or finishes in a repository that uses Jig, shows what the tick did, refuses agent launches into a worktree jig gc is removing, shows the dispatch line in the status bar, and opens a panel on what that line needs from you.

settings.title: Jig command
settings.description: The command that runs Jig, without arguments; the plugin adds `dispatch --apply --repo <repository> --json`. Quotes keep spaces; nothing else is expanded. Empty: the jig plugin installed for Claude Code or Codex, found as Jig's own timer finds it.

settings.title: Launch guard directory
settings.description: Where Jig's launch guard record lives: gc's admissions, this plugin's launch markers and its heartbeat. Set it only when Jig uses another directory; it must name the one Jig uses. Empty: .local/state/jig/orca-guard under the home directory, on every platform.

settings.title: Dispatch interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often Jig's dispatch timer ticks, for a line that does not say. The status bar says the tick is overdue when the newest is older than twice this.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Jig's dispatch line: what needs you, read from jig dispatch line --json.
